pcLinkLimits: PC Link is original Samsung synchronization/support software, not a GNEX SDK or emulator.

Both outer downloads and embedded Microsoft CABs passed 7z tests. The 040331 InstallShield full test returned 1 and reported support-file failures; its complete internal payload integrity is not claimed. The XH31A full InstallShield test returned 0.

Four selected application groups extracted successfully for each build; 248 files / 58,870,667 bytes were structurally scanned, with no SGS. MDAC/installer-engine groups were not included in that SGS scan.
The GVM substring in LinkCore.dll at 0x4cc02 belongs to bitmap-like data and is not treated as a runtime/protocol marker.
The first all-group extraction hit Windows path-length limits. Those partial files are excluded from the selected-group scan counts.
limits: Plain/XOR-A5 scan covers SGS v1/v2/v4/v36 in the inspected bytes. Unknown compression, encryption, fragmentation, ROMized data and native games remain possible.
The embedded ZIP has 56 entries and validated CRCs; all file payloads were scanned separately. It contains Samsung input-method/UI resources and is not identified as either 3D game.
S140/E350/S200/S230 firmware was not recovered by the finite discovery searches. SCH-S390 directory timed out; no absence claim follows.

The official support HTML displays a no-data placeholder but contains five complete file records in serialized Nuxt data. Paths were read as data without evaluating site JavaScript; the static content URL prefix is present in its linked download component.
No phone user files, SMS, contacts, persistent account data or raw S380 memory exported to the public repository.
Original source rights are separate from the Reunion MIT license. Installer and firmware programs were treated as data only.
